title: Data-Driven Free-Energy Learning from Trajectories via Structure-Preserving Exponential Time Differencing
summary: Structure-preserving numerical methods for gradient flows have been extensively developed when the governing equations and free energies are known. However, accurately predicting dynamics from observational data while preserving intrinsic physical properties remains challenging. Although neural operators, such as Fourier neural operators (FNOs), provide powerful data-driven approximations, their predictions do not inherently guarantee physical structure preservation. To address this challenge, we integrate deep learning with structure-preserving exponential time differencing (ETD) methods.…
